observation.visible_scene: Overhead (top-down) view of a stainless-steel kitchen surface with a black cutting board in the center. A person's right forearm and hand hold a green-apple portion steady on the board while the other hand (fingers visible at the top edge) works a thin knife into it. To the left of the held piece lie already-cut apple pieces: one flat wedge and two upright slices. Surrounding the board are static ingredients: a wicker basket with apple slices, cherry tomatoes, garlic and herb sprigs; small glass bowls with red powder, dark beetroot, arugula, pale mustard, peppercorns and oil; white salt/pepper shakers; and a white plate edge at left.
visible_changes: The knife makes repeated short downward/rocking cutting strokes on the rightmost apple portion held by the hand.
The guiding right hand adjusts its grip and slides slightly over the apple piece as the knife works.
The previously cut pieces (flat wedge plus two upright slices) stay in the same positions on the board; no new slice is visibly separated off within this window.
The knife blade's vertical position and angle change frame to frame, indicating an ongoing cutting motion rather than a single completed slice.
Background objects and the camera viewpoint remain fixed throughout (no camera motion).
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether a slice is fully separated before the first frame or after the last frame.
The moment the cutting began and how many total slices will be produced.
What the cut pieces are ultimately used for.
uncertain_details: Exact count and timing of individual cutting strokes, since the motion is small between sampled frames.
Whether the slight hand shift is a repositioning for the next cut or just a minor grip adjustment.
Precise contact point of the blade on the apple in each frame due to motion blur and occlusion by the fingers.
